description: Na₄Cd₃Se₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.13 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.01-3.45 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five Se atoms to form distorted NaSe₅ square pyramids that share corners with four CdSe₄ tetrahedra, edges with four equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, and edges with four CdSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.15 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.08 Å. There are three inequivalent Cd sites. In the first Cd site, Cd is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Cd-Se bond distances ranging from 2.64-2.74 Å. In the second Cd site, Cd is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted CdSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with four CdSe₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaSe₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Cd-Se bond distances ranging from 2.63-2.74 Å. In the third Cd site, Cd is bonded to four Se atoms to form CdSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids, corners with four CdSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaSe₅ square pyramids. There are three shorter (2.67 Å) and one longer (2.69 Å) Cd-Se bond length. There are five inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na and two equivalent Cd atoms. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na and two Cd atoms. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Cd atoms to form SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeNa₄Cd₂ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with four equivalent SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to three Na and three Cd atoms to form SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SeNa₄Cd₂ pentagonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na and two Cd atoms to form distorted SeNa₄Cd₂ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six SeNa₃Cd₃ octahedra and edges with two equivalent SeNa₄Cd₂ pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-75°.
